name: core_organization_security_constraints
preconditionSql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.schema_migrations WHERE version = '0011') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'pk_companies') AS ok;
verificationSql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'pk_companies' AND contype = 'p') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'pk_branch_settings' AND contype = 'p') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'uq_branches__company_code' AND contype = 'u') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'uq_document_tombstones__branch_type_number' AND contype = 'u') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_users__role' AND contype = 'f') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'ck_users__branch_scope_mode' AND contype = 'c') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger WHERE tgname = 'ct_branch_settings__default_warehouse_valid_at_commit' AND NOT tgisinternal) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger WHERE tgname = 'ct_warehouses__preserve_default_reference_at_commit' AND NOT tgisinternal) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger WHERE tgname = 'ct_users__default_branch_access_at_commit' AND NOT tgisinternal) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger WHERE tgname = 'ct_user_branch_access__preserves_default_at_commit' AND NOT tgisinternal) AS ok;
recovery: Transactional failure rolls the migration back. After a successful production apply, recovery is forward-only: preserve Core/Organization/Security data and issue a corrective migration rather than dropping constraints or rewriting committed migration history.
